Subject: Cutover readiness: SSO/SCIM, IP allowlist & service account roster

Alex —

Thanks again for the sync this morning. Per our plan, we want to lock the cutover window and confirm the remaining pieces for your production go-live:

- SSO / SAML: confirm SP metadata we should use (attached placeholder: archway-sp-metadata.xml). Please confirm the entityID and ACS URL we'll be testing against.
- SCIM provisioning: need to confirm attribute mapping (email, username, manager) and whether you want us to provision full group membership or scoped groups only.
- IP allowlist: please provide the egress CIDR(s) your security team will allow for our webhook/callback IPs; we will also provide our egress IPs for the cutover window.
- Service accounts: see attached template (service-accounts-template.csv) — we suggest the naming convention redwood-<env>-<purpose>. Example: redwood-prod-scim. Please fill in owner and intended permissions.

Attachments: SSO-SCIM-cutover-checklist.xlsx, service-accounts-template.csv, archway-sp-metadata.xml (stub).

Proposed cutover windows (pick one):
- Tue 2026-11-16 02:00–04:00 PT (low traffic)
- Thu 2026-11-18 22:00–00:00 PT (for east-coast ops)

Next steps: if you can confirm preferred window and share the SCIM attribute expectations and IP ranges by EOD Thursday (11/12), Monica will run the provisioning test in our staging and Jordan will schedule the dry-run with infra.

Thanks — looking forward to getting this across the line.

Ben Carter

Alex — thanks for the quick response and for confirming Maya as the admin. A few clarifications and actions from our side:

- SP/ACS: we'll validate against staging ACS (https://stg.auth.archway.io/saml/acs) first, then swap to prod ACS after the dry-run.
- SCIM: scoped-groups-only is fine — we'll keep provisioning limited to user objects (username, email, fullName, title, managerId). Monica, we'll use the attribute map below unless you object: userName -> userName, name.givenName -> firstName, name.familyName -> lastName, emails[0].value -> email, manager -> managerId.
- Service accounts: Jordan — please create the following SaaS-facing accounts in staging: redwood-stg-scim (provisioning), redwood-stg-webhook (callbacks). Owners: Alex/Maya. Use least privilege for SCIM (create/update only).
- IP allowlist: Alex — when you share your inbound ranges we will produce a short firewall playbook for your infra team to apply. We will also circulate our egress list by EOD Wednesday (11/11).

Mutual action plan: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/0B1-cutover/MutualActionPlan (linked for timeline and owners).

Action items:
- Alex/Maya: confirm inbound IPs and SP prod ACS by EOD Wed (11/11).
- Monica: run staging SCIM test (create+update) once Alex shares mapping confirmation.
- Jordan: schedule dry-run for Thu 11/18 20:00–21:30 PT (prep) and cutover window 22:00–00:00 PT.

I'll draft a brief Ops checklist and share as an attachment in the next message.

Ben
